articles.summary: Selecting the right point-of-sale (POS) system is one of the most critical technology decisions you'll make for your restaurant or food truck. The right system can streamline operations, boost efficiency, and help you grow your business, while the wrong choice can create headaches and drain your resources. Here are the essential questions you should ask before making your decision.
